final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1.0 * t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -1.0 * t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3) SELECT region, avg_signed_amount, transaction_count, avg_signed_amount / (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) FROM regional) AS ratio_to_regional_average FROM regional WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) FROM regional) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region
